Title: Search route returns a result for a valid query
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/search with a non-empty query | 2. Inspect response body
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 200 and result field contains the submitted query text

Title: Email route sends an email for a valid payload
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/email with valid to/subject/body | 2. Inspect response body

Title: HR route answers a recognized policy question
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/hr with a question mentioning ""leave"" | 2. Inspect response body
Test Data: {"question": "How many leave days do I get?"}
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 200 and answer field references the leave policy document

Title: Coordinator routes an insurance question end-to-end to the HR agent
Preconditions: Backend service is running with all agents wired to their tools
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/coordinator with an insurance-related query | 2. Verify the coordinator delegated to the HR agent | 3. Inspect response body
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 200 and result field references the insurance policy document

Title: Coordinator falls back to the search agent for a generic query
Preconditions: Backend service is running with all agents wired to their tools
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/coordinator with a query unrelated to HR/email | 2. Inspect response body
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 200 and result field contains a search-style placeholder result mentioning the query

Title: HR route returns a graceful fallback for an unmatched topic
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/hr with a question that does not mention leave or insurance | 2. Inspect response body
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 200 with answer "No matching HR policy document found for your question." (no crash)

Title: Coordinator rejects an email-style request without required fields
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/coordinator with a query containing the word ""send"" or ""email"" | 2. Inspect response
Test Data: {"query": "please send an email to the team"}
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 400 with a detail message instructing the caller to use /api/email

Title: Email route accepts an empty body string
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/email with a valid to/subject and an empty body string | 2. Inspect response
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 200 and status field equals sent

Title: Search route rejects an empty query string
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/search with query set to an empty string | 2. Inspect response
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 422 due to schema validation (min_length=1) rather than a 500 error

Title: Email route rejects an address without an @ symbol
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/email with an invalid to value | 2. Inspect response
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 400 with detail message "invalid recipient address: 'not-an-email'"

Title: Missing required field on any route returns a validation error not a server crash
Steps: 1. Send POST /api/search with an empty JSON body | 2. Inspect response
Expected Result: Response is HTTP 422 with a validation error detail and the server remains healthy for subsequent requests
